Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production transparent PNG animation storyboard for ONE horse, 16 distinct contiguous temporal phases of ONE gallop loop.
Input image1: locked Kiruno character identity ONLY, retain exact angular ivory pony with copper-brown sharp origami mane/tail, black-gold horsecloth, gold studs, small crown, small black eye. Input image2: approved game art rendering and horizontal proportions. Do NOT reproduce its single pose repeatedly.
Primary request: generate a NEW, dynamic, anatomically coherent SIXTEEN FRAME full gallop cycle. Precisely EIGHT columns by TWO rows; BOTH rows are RUNNING, NO idle row. Frames are chronological: first row phases0–7, second row phases8–15, finalphase15 smoothly returns to phase0. No labels or text anywhere.
Canvas/grid: approximately2560x896 landscape true transparent PNG. Exactly eight identical equally spaced columns and two identical rows, each cell320x448. Every complete horse about210px wide145px tall, at least45px transparent horizontal gutters inside each cell so no adjacent figures touch. Whole crown, mane, tail, four hooves inside EACH cell. Camera always right-facing exact side/weak3quarter view as reference, scale invariant.
Registration: horse torso/pelvis center around x160 in EVERY cell; fix its mean x coordinate and camera, no forward travel across cells. Do not center each figure by the moving tail or extending muzzle. Running pose body rotates modestly around same torso center, rises and falls about8px total, ±5degrees smooth pitch. Hoof contact baseline y320 within each cell; airborne phases float naturally ABOVE baseline. Same anatomy/scale/identity across all16frames, no character drift.
Motion quality: strongly readable galloping ACTION, not stiff sliding. Longitudinal low horizontal torso; ALL FOUR legs have hip/shoulder, knee/hock and fetlock bends, complete distinct hoof trajectories. Shoulder and hindquarter compression/extension coupled to weight transfer. Neck/head follow center-of-mass smoothly. Mane and tail react with a two-frame lag to body motion; sharp flowing mane planes flex coherently, tail tips trail, not random shape morphs.
Sixteen phase choreography, numbers are instructions ONLY, do not print numbers:
0: front support landing settles, torso low and pitched slightly nose-down; near front hoof at ground, far front beginning contact, hindlegs reaching forward under belly.
1: both frontlegs flex at shoulder/knee, chest sinks into compression, hind hooves advancing forward.
2: front support pushes torso forward/upward while hindlegs gather deeply under pelvis, lowered head begins recovering.
3: frontlegs fold up beneath chest, first rear hoof plants under pelvis, torso starts rising and becoming level.
4: rear weight accepted, both hindlegs compress with bent hocks under pelvis, frontlegs swing forward folded.
5: powerful hindleg extension pushes off ground; torso rotates nose-up3degrees, front knees begin opening forward, tail lags low.
6: final rear hoof toe-off, hindlegs sweep backward, frontlegs stretch forward, whole body rising into full flight.
7: full extended suspension, both frontlegs reach forward and rearlegs extend backward, torso near highest point slightly nose-up, head streamlined forward.
8: flight continues, front hooves begin downstroke, rearlegs start folding behind, torso approaches level.
9: leading front hoof descends toward ground, second front follows, rear hocks fold forward; body begins falling.
10: first front hoof touches ground ahead of shoulder, second frontleg still reaching, nose pitches down smoothly.
11: second front hoof contacts, first front knee bends accepting weight, hindlegs swing forward under belly.
12: deep landing compression, front elbows/knees flex and torso sinks, neck dips, hindlegs gather underneath.
13: front support rebounds gradually, frontlegs begin lifting/folding, hindlegs reach farther forward toward next rear plant.
14: compressed gathered flight/changeover, all legs tightly folded under low torso, ears/crown move with head, mane/tail sweep forward slightly from inertia.
15: near frontleg extends down toward the exact phase0 support pose, second front catches, hindlegs position for same phase0 gather; smooth low body tilt matching phase0 so seamless closure.
Use correct natural continuous gallop, adapt subtle foot choreography if needed to maintain anatomically plausible contact sequence. Adjacent frames smoothly progress across ALL16phases, but extension vs collection vs impact poses MUST be obviously different. No16near-identical stances, no legs-only pendulum cycle.
Rendering: original sharp angular faceted fantasy pony, small head-to-body ratio, short compact angular hoof limbs; warm rim lights and clean ivory facets, copper brown mane and tail; exactly existing black/gold horsecloth and small crown. NOT plush, not upright toy, not unicorn, not oversized Disney head/eyes, no added jewelry.
Background: genuine transparent alpha outside horse in every cell, no ground, dust, cast shadow, glowing ground ring, plate, scenery, grid, arrows, labels, letters, watermark. ONE identical horse each cell, exactly16 complete distinct running poses, no idle poses.
